buildCommand: if [ "$VERCEL_ENV" = "production" ]; then previous="${VERCEL_GIT_PREVIOUS_COMMIT_SHA:-}"; if [ -n "$previous" ] && git cat-file -e "$previous^{commit}" 2>/dev/null; then if ! git diff --quiet "$previous" "$VERCEL_GIT_COMMIT_SHA" -- drizzle; then if [ -n "$DATABASE_URL" ]; then pnpm db:migrate; fi; fi; elif [ -n "$DATABASE_URL" ]; then pnpm db:migrate; fi; fi && pnpm run build:static
